description: The bar chart titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks" compares the performance of two models, LLLaMA-3-8B-it and "Ours (Iterative RLHF)," across various datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics, which include GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the score percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. Each dataset and metric has two bars adjacent to each other, one for each model, with the LLLaMA-3-8B-it model represented in blue and the "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model in orange. The bars are sorted in descending order of the LLLaMA-3-8B-it model's performance, starting with the highest score of 80 for GSM-8K and ending with the lowest score of 20 for Chat-Arena-Hard. The "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model generally shows comparable or slightly lower scores than the LLLaMA-3-8B-it model, with the exception of the TruthfulQA dataset, where the "Ours" model scores slightly higher. The chart includes a legend in the upper right corner, indicating the color coding for each model. The chart is designed to provide a clear visual comparison of the two models' performance across the different benchmarks without any annotations of data values above the bars.
